mte.name: mte
mte.documentation: Princeton Instruments PI-MTE: 2048B (e2v CCD 42-40, back-illuminated, 2048x2048, 13.5 um) on USB 2.0, s/n 02062413. Driven directly through PICam (ctypes); LightField must be closed. Writes SWMR HDF5 + StreamResource/StreamDatum to <data_root>/<tiled_beamline>/pi_mte, referenced as /data/<tiled_beamline>/pi_mte (bcgtiled, where shussebora copies it); shussebora is notified when each file closes.
